description: Look up a product barcode number: identify and validate EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, GTIN-14, ISBN-13/10, ISSN and ISMN codes (wrong check digits are reported with the correct digit), convert between forms (GTIN-14, EAN-13, UPC-A, ISBN-10 <-> 13) and decode the GS1 prefix. Then fetch product data from open databases: name, brand, quantity, categories, image, labels, Nutri-Score (food, cosmetics, pet food via Open Food Facts) or title, authors, publisher and cover (books via Open Library). Paid ($0.001, x402).

code.description: Barcode number: 8/12/13/14 digits or ISBN-10 (spaces and hyphens ignored), e.g. 3017620422003

lookup.description: Also fetch product / book data from open databases (false = validate and convert only)

name: lookup_product_code
title: lookup product code
